relation: equivalent Prop encodings of upstream full-carrier perfection: direct subset chi=omega or induced-carrier chi=omega; not definitionally identical
summary: C12 reuses GraphTheory.wpgt.perfect_mem as canonical mathematical owner. GTBase.perfect_graphs.is_perfect_graph is its full-carrier Boolean predicate viewed as Prop. The public API proves reflection and both forall-subset and forall-induced-carrier characterizations without propositional extensionality.

Both legacy Prop signatures remain unchanged. D2ram quantifies directly over subsets; X144 uses all induced carriers. Upstream chiT/omegaT and chi_induced/omega_induced reconcile them, including the empty subset. No nonempty graph/set, connectivity or size guard is introduced.

Both exact source bodies and both complete rows are frozen. Preserve D2ram uniform threshold N, graph-then-size order, and the entire G/complement biclique disjunction with both power bounds. Preserve X144 size-then-graph order, its two explicit nonempty pure-pair guards and complete-or-anticomplete disjunction. These output predicates are not identified or rewritten.

D2ram perfect_graph_complete and perfect_graph_whole retain exact theorem types and now use the corresponding public API lemmas; every other grounding/implication proof remains unchanged, including the D2ram_nodes_in_scope whole-row equality. No earlier frozen row reaches this family and no historical Original is owed. D2ram edge_count is a separate A7 hunk and must remain preserved at integration.

Public-only examples include K0/K1/K2/Kn, edgeless complements, the empty induced subset, isomorphism/induced transport, and an actual cycle_graph5 negative. The latter proves alpha<=2 and omega<=2 by five membership cases and applies upstream Hajnal, avoiding chromatic-number partition enumeration. All existing docs/statuses remain unchanged; exact kernel types/closures and independent step-10/root final review are required.

A21 preserves both existing C12 whole-row snapshots and all frozen perfection bodies. Its appended D2ramOriginal and X144Original whole rows additionally freeze the raw supplied-pair contracts, without changing the graph/complement disjunction, nonemptiness guards, power bounds or quantifier order. Reciprocal snapshot notes identify both complete compositions.
